name: Unraid-Home
description: Self-populating homepage for your Unraid server. Scans Docker for containers and shows each one as a tile with its WebUI link, icon and status. Edit mode (from your home network) lets you rename, regroup, pin and hide tiles, add links and pages, and pick themes. Optional: login with authenticator sign-in, alerts (ntfy, Gotify, Discord, webhook, email), uptime and update badges, server stats, and automation for Nginx Proxy Manager and Cloudflare Tunnel so your apps get internet addresses automatically. All settings are optional. Almost everything is set on the homepage itself: click Settings (home network only). What you set there is saved in /config/options.json. Only the few values on this template page that the container needs before it can start (the Docker address, proxy trust, the password and the mapped folders) stay here. Email alerts with Gmail need an app password (https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords), not your normal Google password. Built entirely by AI (Claude, by Anthropic). Features are tested, but not every situation has been, so do your own due diligence before exposing it to the internet: keep the login on, use a strong password and 2FA, and review your Cloudflare, proxy and firewall settings. Use at your own risk.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Used to discover containers (and, only if you turn on Container controls, to start/stop/restart them). Note: the read-only flag does not limit what the Docker API allows.

paths.name: Unraid templates
paths.description: Optional. Lets the hover summaries use each app's Overview text from its Unraid template. Read-only; only the name, repository, overview and category are read.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Stores your settings, tile overrides, custom links and visitor history

paths.name: Update status file
paths.description: Optional. Lets tiles show an Update badge for containers Unraid says are out of date. Read-only.

paths.name: Disk stats: array
paths.description: Optional. Read-only. Lets the stats strip show array usage.

paths.name: Disk stats: cache
paths.description: Optional. Read-only. Lets the stats strip show cache usage.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the homepage is served on

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Login password (12+ characters). Leave blank to have one generated on first start; it is printed once in this container's log and stored only as a salted hash. This is the one setting the Settings page cannot change; use Change password there instead once the container is running.

variables.name: Docker address
variables.description: Where to ask about containers. Leave as-is when the Docker socket above is mapped in. Use tcp://docker-socket-proxy:2375 if you run a socket proxy instead (recommended when this page is reachable from the internet). Settings page shows this one read-only.

variables.name: Trust proxy headers
variables.description: On (default) believes the address headers from a reverse proxy or Cloudflare tunnel on your network, so the real visitor address and country are recorded. Turn off only if nothing in front of this page adds those headers. Settings page shows this one read-only.
